simple.summary: חֲצַר הַתִּיכוֹן (Chătsar hat-Tîykôwn) means Chatsar-hat-Tikon , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Ezek 47 16.

definitions.full: H2694. Chatser Hattikon הַתִּיכוֺן חָצֵר proper name, of a location Ezek 47:16 ᵐ5 Sm Co עינון חָצֵ֫רָה (q. v.); it is described as חַוְרָן אֶלגְּֿבוּל אֲשֶׁר ; Wetzst ZKW, 1884 , see 114 identification with „adar () 'at the foot of the eastern corner of Hermon.'
